fullText.simplified:
第十三章、过好这一生

    戴利回到了会古市，但他找不到他和阿意的家了。
    他问了很多路人，但没有几个人能回答他的问题。他已经离开八十多天了，在会古这就是八十多年。八十多年前的人和事还有几个人会记得呢？
    雪花落在戴利的身上，他的心越来越冷。他走了一个晚上，也找了一个晚上。那个他和阿意的家，他再也找不到了。
    第二天早上，他还在街上走着。雪早就停了，街边的花开了，很漂亮，就像以前他和阿意在院子里看的那些花。花告诉戴利，昨晚的冬天已经过去了，现在是春天了，新的一年到了。
    戴利累极了，他在花边坐下。不知道坐了多久，伤心的他倒在地上睡着了。
    等他再醒来时，发现他已经回到了自己的家。书桌上放着书和茶，茶还飘着香气，好像他只是睡了一会儿。刚刚在会古市过的那一晚，好像是另一个梦。
    现在梦醒了，他也醒了。会古市和阿意，他再也见不到了。
    戴利又想起了阿意的话：“人都会变老的。阿利，我会变老，我们的孩子会变老。在你的世界，你也会变老的。不要害怕变老，我们已经幸福地在一起生活了三十六年了，我很高兴。”
    和戴利比较，阿意的一生太短了，但阿意的一生过得很幸福，她把每一天都过好了。戴利的一生很长，他有更多的时间。现在，他已经明白了，生命的长短不重要，怎样过好一生才重要。他要像阿意那样，过好生命里的每一天。
    戴利慢慢地把桌上的茶喝了。这时候，他又看到了桌上的那些书，那是他以前经常看的关于神仙的书。这个“以前“其实也才几个月前，那时候的戴利很羡慕神仙，希望自己能做个神仙。为什么想做神仙呢？答案是神仙可以长生不老。但是现在好好想一想，阿意的一生是一生，戴利的一生是一生，神仙的一生也是一生。这些“一生“除了时间长短不一样，其他又有什么不同呢？所以，在明白了什么才是生命里最重要的东西以后，现在的戴利觉得，做不做神仙好像也没那么重要了。
fullText.traditional:
第十三章、過好這一生

    戴利回到了會古市，但他找不到他和阿意的家了。
    他問了很多路人，但沒有幾個人能回答他的問題。他已經離開八十多天了，在會古這就是八十多年。八十多年前的人和事還有幾個人會記得呢？
    雪花落在戴利的身上，他的心越來越冷。他走了一個晚上，也找了一個晚上。那個他和阿意的家，他再也找不到了。
    第二天早上，他還在街上走著。雪早就停了，街邊的花開了，很漂亮，就像以前他和阿意在院子裡看的那些花。花告訴戴利，昨晚的冬天已經過去了，現在是春天了，新的一年到了。
    戴利累極了，他在花邊坐下。不知道坐了多久，傷心的他倒在地上睡著了。
    等他再醒來時，發現他已經回到了自己的家。書桌上放著書和茶，茶還飄著香氣，好像他只是睡了一會兒。剛剛在會古市過的那一晚，好像是另一個夢。
    現在夢醒了，他也醒了。會古市和阿意，他再也見不到了。
    戴利又想起了阿意的話：“人都會變老的。阿利，我會變老，我們的孩子會變老。在你的世界，你也會變老的。不要害怕變老，我們已經幸福地在一起生活了三十六年了，我很高興。”
    和戴利比較，阿意的一生太短了，但阿意的一生過得很幸福，她把每一天都過好了。戴利的一生很長，他有更多的時間。現在，他已經明白了，生命的長短不重要，怎樣過好一生才重要。他要像阿意那樣，過好生命裡的每一天。
    戴利慢慢地把桌上的茶喝了。這時候，他又看到了桌上的那些書，那是他以前經常看的關於神仙的書。這個“以前“其實也才幾個月前，那時候的戴利很羨慕神仙，希望自己能做個神仙。為什麼想做神仙呢？答案是神仙可以長生不老。但是現在好好想一想，阿意的一生是一生，戴利的一生是一生，神仙的一生也是一生。這些“一生“除了時間長短不一樣，其他又有什麼不同呢？所以，在明白了什麼才是生命裡最重要的東西以後，現在的戴利覺得，做不做神仙好像也沒那麼重要了。

sentences.simplified: 戴利回到了会古市，但他找不到他和阿意的家了。
sentences.traditional: 戴利回到了會古市，但他找不到他和阿意的家了。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì huí dào le huì gǔ shì dàn tā zhǎo bú dào tā hé ā yì de jiā le
sentences.english: Dai Li returned to Huigu City, but he couldn’t find his and Ah Yi’s home.

sentences.simplified: 他问了很多路人，但没有几个人能回答他的问题。
sentences.traditional: 他問了很多路人，但沒有幾個人能回答他的問題。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn le hěn duō lù rén dàn méi yǒu jǐ ge rén néng huí dá tā de wèn tí
sentences.english: He asked many passersby, but few people could answer his questions.

sentences.simplified: 他已经离开八十多天了，在会古这就是八十多年。
sentences.traditional: 他已經離開八十多天了，在會古這就是八十多年。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng lí kāi bā shí duō tiān le zài huì gǔ zhè jiù shì bā shí duō nián
sentences.english: He had already left for more than 80 days, which in Huigu was more than 80 years.

sentences.simplified: 八十多年前的人和事还有几个人会记得呢？
sentences.traditional: 八十多年前的人和事還有幾個人會記得呢？
sentences.pinyin: bā shí duō nián qián de rén hé shì hái yǒu jǐ ge rén huì jì de ne
sentences.english: Who could remember the people and things that happened more than 80 years ago?

sentences.simplified: 雪花落在戴利的身上，他的心越来越冷。
sentences.traditional: 雪花落在戴利的身上，他的心越來越冷。
sentences.pinyin: xuě huā luò zài dài lì de shēn shang tā de xīn yuè lái yuè lěng
sentences.english: Snowflakes fell onto Dai Li’s body, and his heart grew colder and colder.

sentences.simplified: 他走了一个晚上，也找了一个晚上。那个他和阿意的家，他再也找不到了。
sentences.traditional: 他走了一個晚上，也找了一個晚上。那個他和阿意的家，他再也找不到了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu le yí ge wǎn shang yě zhǎo le yí ge wǎn shang nà ge tā hé ā yì de jiā tā zài yě zhǎo bú dào le
sentences.english: He walked for the entire night and searched for the entire night. He could no longer find his and Ah Yi’s home.

sentences.simplified: 第二天早上，他还在街上走着。
sentences.traditional: 第二天早上，他還在街上走著。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān zǎo shang tā hái zài jiē shang zǒu zhe
sentences.english: The next morning, he was still walking on the streets.

sentences.simplified: 雪早就停了，街边的花开了，
sentences.traditional: 雪早就停了，街邊的花開了，
sentences.pinyin: xuě zǎo jiù tíng le jiē biān de huā kāi le
sentences.english: The snow had stopped long ago, and the flowers were blooming on the street.

sentences.simplified: 很漂亮，就像以前他和阿意在院子里看的那些花。
sentences.traditional: 很漂亮，就像以前他和阿意在院子裡看的那些花。
sentences.pinyin: hěn piào liang jiù xiàng yǐ qián tā hé ā yì zài yuàn zi lǐ kàn de nà xiē huā
sentences.english: They were very pretty, just like the ones he and Ah Yi looked at in their courtyard.

sentences.simplified: 花告诉戴利，昨晚的冬天已经过去了，现在是春天了，新的一年到了。
sentences.traditional: 花告訴戴利，昨晚的冬天已經過去了，現在是春天了，新的一年到了。
sentences.pinyin: huā gào su dài lì zuó wǎn de dōng tiān yǐ jīng guò qù le xiàn zài shì chūn tiān le xīn de yì nián dào le
sentences.english: The flowers told Dai Li that last night’s winter had already passed. Now it was spring. A new year had arrived.

sentences.simplified: 戴利累极了，他在花边坐下。
sentences.traditional: 戴利累極了，他在花邊坐下。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì lèi jí le tā zài huā biān zuò xià
sentences.english: Dai Li was extremely tired. He sat down beside the flowers.

sentences.simplified: 不知道坐了多久，伤心的他倒在地上睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 不知道坐了多久，傷心的他倒在地上睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào zuò le duō jiǔ shāng xīn de tā dǎo zài dì shang shuì zháo le
sentences.english: He didn’t know how long he sat for. Brokenhearted, he collapsed onto the ground and fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 等他再醒来时，发现他已经回到了自己的家。
sentences.traditional: 等他再醒來時，發現他已經回到了自己的家。
sentences.pinyin: děng tā zài xǐng lái shí fā xiàn tā yǐ jīng huí dào le zì jǐ de jiā
sentences.english: When he next awoke, he discovered he had already returned to his own home.

sentences.simplified: 书桌上放着书和茶，茶还飘着香气，好像他只是睡了一会儿。
sentences.traditional: 書桌上放著書和茶，茶還飄著香氣，好像他只是睡了一會兒。
sentences.pinyin: shū zhuō shang fàng zhe shū hé chá chá hái piāo zhe xiāng qì hǎo xiàng tā zhǐ shì shuì le yí huì'r
sentences.english: There were books and tea on the desk. The tea still carried an aromatic scent, as if he had only slept for a little while.

sentences.simplified: 刚刚在会古市过的那一晚，好像是另一个梦。
sentences.traditional: 剛剛在會古市過的那一晚，好像是另一個夢。
sentences.pinyin: gāng gang zài huì gǔ shì guò de nà yì wǎn hǎo xiàng shì lìng yí ge mèng
sentences.english: The night he had just spent in Huigu was like another dream.

sentences.simplified: 现在梦醒了，他也醒了。会古市和阿意，他再也见不到了。
sentences.traditional: 現在夢醒了，他也醒了。會古市和阿意，他再也見不到了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài mèng xǐng le tā yě xǐng le huì gǔ shì hé ā yì tā zài yě jiàn bú dào le
sentences.english: He had woken from his dream, and he had also woken up. He could no longer see Huigu City and Ah Yi.

sentences.simplified: 戴利又想起了阿意的话：“人都会变老的。阿利，我会变老，我们的孩子会变老。
sentences.traditional: 戴利又想起了阿意的話：“人都會變老的。阿利，我會變老，我們的孩子會變老。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì yòu xiǎng qǐ le ā yì de huà rén dōu huì biàn lǎo de ā lì wǒ huì biàn lǎo wǒ men de hái zi huì biàn lǎo
sentences.english: Dai Li again thought of Ah Yi’s words: “Everyone will grow old. Ah Li, I will grow old, and our son will grow old.

sentences.simplified: 在你的世界，你也会变老的。
sentences.traditional: 在你的世界，你也會變老的。
sentences.pinyin: zài nǐ de shì jiè nǐ yě huì biàn lǎo de
sentences.english: In your world, you also will grow old.

sentences.simplified: 不要害怕变老，我们已经幸福地在一起生活了三十六年了，我很高兴。”
sentences.traditional: 不要害怕變老，我們已經幸福地在一起生活了三十六年了，我很高興。”
sentences.pinyin: bú yào hài pà biàn lǎo wǒ men yǐ jīng xìng fú de zài yì qǐ shēng huó le sān shí liù nián le wǒ hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Don’t be afraid of growing old. We have already lived happily for 36 years together. I am really happy.”

sentences.simplified: 和戴利比较，阿意的一生太短了，但阿意的一生过得很幸福，她把每一天都过好了。
sentences.traditional: 和戴利比較，阿意的一生太短了，但阿意的一生過得很幸福，她把每一天都過好了。
sentences.pinyin: hé dài lì bǐ jiào ā yì de yì shēng tài duǎn le dàn ā yì de yì shēng guò de hěn xìng fú tā bǎ měi yì tiān dōu guò hǎo le
sentences.english: Compared to Dai Li, Ah Yi’s life was too short, but Ah Yi’s life was very happy. She lived each day well.

sentences.simplified: 戴利的一生很长，他有更多的时间。
sentences.traditional: 戴利的一生很長，他有更多的時間。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì de yì shēng hěn cháng tā yǒu gèng duō de shí jiān
sentences.english: Dai Li’s life was very long. He had more time.

sentences.simplified: 现在，他已经明白了，生命的长短不重要，怎样过好一生才重要。
sentences.traditional: 現在，他已經明白了，生命的長短不重要，怎樣過好一生才重要。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài tā yǐ jīng míng bai le shēng mìng de cháng duǎn bú zhòng yào zěn yàng guò hǎo yì shēng cái zhòng yào
sentences.english: Now, he already understood that the length of one’s life was not important. It’s how to live one’s life well that’s important.

sentences.simplified: 他要像阿意那样，过好生命里的每一天。
sentences.traditional: 他要像阿意那樣，過好生命裡的每一天。
sentences.pinyin: tā yào xiàng ā yì nà yàng guò hǎo shēng mìng lǐ de měi yì tiān
sentences.english: He wanted to be like Ah Yi, to live each day of his life well.

sentences.simplified: 戴利慢慢地把桌上的茶喝了。
sentences.traditional: 戴利慢慢地把桌上的茶喝了。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì màn man de bǎ zhuō shàng de chá hē le
sentences.english: Dai Li slowly drank the tea on the desk.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，他又看到了桌上的那些书，那是他以前经常看的关于神仙的书。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，他又看到了桌上的那些書，那是他以前經常看的關於神仙的書。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou tā yòu kàn dào le zhuō shàng de nà xiē shū nà shì tā yǐ qián jīng cháng kàn de guān yú shén xiān de shū
sentences.english: At this time, he looked at the books on his desk. They were books about immortals that he frequently read in the past.

sentences.simplified: 这个“以前“其实也才几个月前，
sentences.traditional: 這個“以前“其實也才幾個月前，
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge yǐ qián qí shí yě cái jǐ ge yuè qián
sentences.english: This “in the past“ was actually just a few months ago.

sentences.simplified: 那时候的戴利很羡慕神仙，希望自己能做个神仙。
sentences.traditional: 那時候的戴利很羨慕神仙，希望自己能做個神仙。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou de dài lì hěn xiàn mù shén xiān xī wàng zì jǐ néng zuò ge shén xiān
sentences.english: At that time, Dai Li was really envious of immortals and hoped that he could become an immortal himself.

sentences.simplified: 为什么想做神仙呢？答案是神仙可以长生不老。
sentences.traditional: 為什麼想做神仙呢？答案是神仙可以長生不老。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me xiǎng zuò shén xiān ne dá àn shì shén xiān kě yǐ cháng shēng bù lǎo
sentences.english: Why did he want to be an immortal? The answer was that immortals can live forever and not grow old.

sentences.simplified: 但是现在好好想一想，阿意的一生是一生，戴利的一生是一生，神仙的一生也是一生。
sentences.traditional: 但是現在好好想一想，阿意的一生是一生，戴利的一生是一生，神仙的一生也是一生。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài hǎo hǎo xiǎng yi xiǎng ā yì de yì shēng shì yì shēng dài lì de yì shēng shì yì shēng shén xiān de yì shēng yě shì yì shēng
sentences.english: But now he thought about it, Ah Yi’s life is a life, Dai Li’s life is a life, and an immortal’s life is also a life.

sentences.simplified: 这些“一生“除了时间长短不一样，其他又有什么不同呢？
sentences.traditional: 這些“一生“除了時間長短不一樣，其他又有什麼不同呢？
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē yì shēng chú le shí jiān cháng duǎn bù yí yàng qí tā yòu yǒu shén me bù tóng ne
sentences.english: Other than these “lives” having different durations, what else is different?

sentences.simplified: 所以，在明白了什么才是生命里最重要的东西以后，现在的戴利觉得，做不做神仙好像也没那么重要了。
sentences.traditional: 所以，在明白了什麼才是生命裡最重要的東西以後，現在的戴利覺得，做不做神仙好像也沒那麼重要了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zài míng bai le shén me cái shì shēng mìng lǐ zuì zhòng yào de dōng xi yǐ hòu xiàn zài de dài lì jué de zuò bú zuò shén xiān hǎo xiàng yě méi nà me zhòng yào le
sentences.english: So, after understanding what the most important thing in life is, Dai Li now thought that becoming an immortal was not so important anymore.

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: Live This Life Well
Dai Li returned to Huigu City, but he couldn’t find his and Ah Yi’s home.
He asked many passersby, but few people could answer his questions.
He had already left for more than 80 days, which in Huigu was more than 80 years.
Who could remember the people and things that happened more than 80 years ago?
Snowflakes fell onto Dai Li’s body, and his heart grew colder and colder.
He walked for the entire night and searched for the entire night. He could no longer find his and Ah Yi’s home.
The next morning, he was still walking on the streets.
The snow had stopped long ago, and the flowers were blooming on the street.
They were very pretty, just like the ones he and Ah Yi looked at in their courtyard.
The flowers told Dai Li that last night’s winter had already passed. Now it was spring. A new year had arrived.
Dai Li was extremely tired. He sat down beside the flowers.
He didn’t know how long he sat for. Brokenhearted, he collapsed onto the ground and fell asleep.
When he next awoke, he discovered he had already returned to his own home.
There were books and tea on the desk. The tea still carried an aromatic scent, as if he had only slept for a little while.
The night he had just spent in Huigu was like another dream.
He had woken from his dream, and he had also woken up. He could no longer see Huigu City and Ah Yi.
Dai Li again thought of Ah Yi’s words: “Everyone will grow old. Ah Li, I will grow old, and our son will grow old.
In your world, you also will grow old.
Don’t be afraid of growing old. We have already lived happily for 36 years together. I am really happy.”
Compared to Dai Li, Ah Yi’s life was too short, but Ah Yi’s life was very happy. She lived each day well.
Dai Li’s life was very long. He had more time.
Now, he already understood that the length of one’s life was not important. It’s how to live one’s life well that’s important.
He wanted to be like Ah Yi, to live each day of his life well.
Dai Li slowly drank the tea on the desk.
At this time, he looked at the books on his desk. They were books about immortals that he frequently read in the past.
This “in the past“ was actually just a few months ago.
At that time, Dai Li was really envious of immortals and hoped that he could become an immortal himself.
Why did he want to be an immortal? The answer was that immortals can live forever and not grow old.
But now he thought about it, Ah Yi’s life is a life, Dai Li’s life is a life, and an immortal’s life is also a life.
Other than these “lives” having different durations, what else is different?
So, after understanding what the most important thing in life is, Dai Li now thought that becoming an immortal was not so important anymore.
